summary: A mixed day led by Reliance's major capital commitments and Tata governance turmoil, with a legal win for Pearson's counsel providing precedent relief for in-house practitioners.

bullets.text: Karnataka High Court quashed criminal case against Pearson Education's former in-house counsel, providing legal protection for corporate legal officers.
Reliance committed Rs 10 lakh crore ($120 billion) over seven years for AI infrastructure to dramatically reduce AI deployment costs.
Reliance to raise $1.3 billion in rupee bond sale, its first since 2023, signaling capital market access amid expansion plans.
L Catterton acquired minority stake in Nandhana Foods for $30 million, marking significant foreign investment in South Indian restaurant chain.
Tata Sons board reappointed N Chandrasekaran as executive chairman for five years; Tata trusts challenged legality and opposed listing plans.
